title: add-benchmark-lab-representative-runners-reporting-pipeline-v63
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: our benchmark lab needs updated representative workload runners (v63) to cover recent mixed and multi-variant workloads and to produce the new reporting schema expected by the metrics pipeline. This PR adds: 1) representative workload runners for mixed-text, streaming-chat, and embedding-heavy profiles (python runners and a lightweight go harness); 2) profiling baselines for memory and cold-start throughput (v63 baselines) and a small suite of microbenchmarks; 3) reporting pipeline changes: new BigQuery ingestion schema (report_v63), Prometheus exporter updates, and a compatibility shim for existing dashboards; 4) CI updates: new benchmark CI stage with optional smoke-run on PRs and nightly full runs; 5) docs and quickstart snippets for running the new runners locally and in the benchmark lab. Checklist: - [x] add representative runners (python + go) - [x] add profiling baselines and microbenchmarks - [x] add reporting schema and BigQuery ingestion job - [x] add Prometheus metric labels and exporter tests - [x] update docs and quickstarts - [x] CI pipeline integration and smoke tests Backwards compatibility: reporting shim keeps legacy fields and populates new report_v63 fields when available; dashboards are updated via config so no breaking dashboards expected. Deployment notes: dataflow job needs a new service account permission (bigquery.jobs.create) in benchmark-lab project before nightly pipeline runs. Related: ENG-3421 (coverage gaps), ENG-3578 (reporting schema v63).
